title: Optimize inverted index average length update
constraints: Preserve BM25 scoring inputs and serialized index shape
rationale: InvertedIndex::add_document recalculated avg_doc_length by summing every stored document length after each inserted document. The previous average and document count are enough to update the average incrementally without changing the persisted struct layout.
steps: Pre-size term frequency HashMap from token count
Replace full doc_lengths sum with an incremental total length calculation
Add unit tests for average length updates and duplicate doc_id compatibility
Run inverted index and FTS integration regressions
expected_impact: Avoids O(n) document length scans during each inverted-index document insertion, improving FTS index build/update paths.
